proposal.title: ML Sports Betting: Project Proposal
proposal.exclude_as_current_proposal: project_proposal.pdf is a separate September25 EPL prediction-market proposal
proposal.question: Does calibration-based versus accuracy-based selection improve value-betting performance, and do archived best prices improve the replay?
planned_pipeline: season-to-date opponent-relative statistics and prior-season strength
KS drift screen, Spearman redundancy, forward selection, BO-TPE
LR, RF, SVM, MLP in accuracy/ECE branches

shared_implemented_framework: Lag earlier completed game statistics; do not use the target game as its own predictor.
Predict NBA home/away and EPL home/draw/away probabilities.
Compare initial accuracy and calibration selection branches across the four common model families.
Use prior seasons for fitting/selection and later seasons for betting evaluation.
Compare model probabilities to decimal-odds implied probabilities and normalised market probabilities.
Translate declared choices and stakes into archived-price hypothetical accounts.
Separate forecast accuracy/calibration from selected-bet hit ratio and financial returns.

features.exclude_target_rows: First10 appearances of each team are excluded as prediction targets: both GAME_NUM values>10 means at least10 prior appearances.
features.spearman: absolute correlation>0.7; retain stronger absolute association with binary target

ece.warning: Penalty sentinel must not be called literal100% empirical miscalibration.

betting.selection: home-first if p_home>1/O_home; else away if1-p_home>1/O_away; no max-edge comparison
betting.allocation: Sequential per-game cash settlement, not joint same-date requests

rolling_extension.window: two training seasons, one validation, one following season included in final refit, then next betting season
rolling_extension.source_stitched_cumulative_path: additively joins annual-reset profits; not a continuously funded portfolio after ruin

first_experiment.classwise_ECE: mean of3 one-vs-rest class errors;10bins; emptybins0; nooccupancy penalty
first_experiment.Brier: unscaled3class squared errors summed acrossclass then averaged; range0to2

training_screens.KS: early/later halves of training seasons only; BH q<0.01 AND KSdistance>0.15
training_screens.Spearman: rank by max absolute association with one-versus-rest targets; drop redundancy>=0.9
training_screens.SFS: logistic wrapper using two expanding chronological training folds; candidate_limit18,max_selected8,stoppingrule

epl_methods.allocation: All same-date requests use openingcash and are reduced proportionally to availablecash and anydatebudget before settlement.

comparability_warnings: Do not pool binaryNBA Brier with unscaled3classEPL Brier; comparemodelagainstmarketwithinleague.
Do not equate NBA20-bin occupancy-penalisedECE with EPL10-bin averageclassECE.
Do not equate NBAcapitalreturn-labelledROI with EPLturnoverROI.
Do not assign EPLtemperaturecalibration, max-edge rule, per-bet2%cap or jointdatecashfunding toNBA.
Do not claim theNBArollingextension reruns4familyTPE; itusesLRonly.
Do not splice separately resetNBAannualaccounts into a legitimate fundedcontinuous100Kcurve.
Do not claimcalibrationguaranteesprofit or that lackofimprovement proves nofeaturecouldeverwork.
Do not calla3.87%overrounda directtransactionfee or realisedbookmakerprofit.
Do not presentEPLforecastsasexecutedtrades; pendingquote-freeforecasts have no prospectivePnL.
